I am an old farmer in Amhara. I have been farming this land since I was a young boy, and my father taught me everything I know. My maize plot is small, only half a hectare, but it is good land that my family owns. I will use improved seed because the government extension worker brought it to our village last year and my neighbor got a better harvest with it. I have some urea and DAP from the cooperative, so I will put that on the plot, but not too much because it is expensive and I must also save some for my other fields. I have oxen and my sons help me, so we will do the work ourselves with family labor, though I may hire two or three young men from the village for a few days at harvest time if the crop looks good. We do not have water for irrigation here, and I do not use chemicals for pests because we cannot afford them and we pull the weeds by hand.
